contribution.position: My position is unchanged: on reliability grounds this change is not ready. artifact:perf-report measures p99 latency at 410ms under peak load — 64% over the 250ms budget — and artifact:incident-log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter from retry storms, the exact failure mode that elevated latency under load tends to trigger. Note that QA's turn cited 180ms from the same perf report, but the artifact on record says 410ms at peak; the numbers in evidence do not support the 'comfortably inside budget' reading. artifact:test-report confirms functional correctness (412 passed, 87% coverage) but says nothing about behavior under load, so the reliability evidence still points against the current state until the latency regression is explained or mitigated.
